file.title: File upload
file.desc: Upload a CSV, XLSX or JSON file; it is parsed in the browser and imported in batches.

rest.title: REST pull
rest.desc: Pull records incrementally from a business system’s REST API on a schedule.

webhook.title: Webhook push
webhook.desc: External systems push records to you, verified with an HMAC signature.

list.title: Data integration
list.description: Manage data sources, import jobs and data quality.
list.emptyHint: Create a data source to bring business data into ontology objects.

state.pausedHint: A breaking ontology change may have invalidated the mapping. Update the mapping, then re-enable the source.

jobs.title: Import jobs
jobs.counts: Received {received, number} · written {upserted, number} · rejected {rejected, number}

delete.label: Delete {name}
delete.title: Delete data source
delete.body: Delete the data source “{name}”? Imported objects are kept, but this source stops ingesting.

wizard.title: New data source
wizard.description: Five steps: choose source → upload or connect → field mapping → quality rules → preview & run.
wizard.createFailed: Could not save the data source

subtitle.file: Files are parsed in a background thread and never block the page.
subtitle.rest: Enter the endpoint and the path of the records; sensitive headers are stored encrypted.
subtitle.webhook: You get a push URL and signing secret after creation.

upload.dropTitle: Drop a file here, or click to choose
upload.dropHint: CSV (header row), XLSX or JSON array; up to {maxMb} MB and {maxRows, number} rows per file
upload.fieldsDetected: {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} detected ({format})
upload.fileRequired: Upload and parse a file first.

errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds {maxMb} MB. Please split the file and import the parts separately.
errors.TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file has more than {maxRows, number} rows. Please split the file and import the parts separately.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Unsupported file format. Upload a CSV, XLSX or JSON file.
errors.EMPTY_FILE: The file contains no data rows.
errors.INVALID_JSON: Invalid JSON: expected an array of objects (or an object with an items / data array).
errors.PARSE_FAILED: The file could not be parsed. Check its content and encoding (UTF-8).

settings.title: Source settings
settings.subtitle: Records are written to the selected object type.
settings.name: Source name
settings.targetTypeChangeHint: Changing the target type resets the field mapping and quality rules.

txnHint.APPEND: Adds or updates records; objects missing from this import are untouched.
txnHint.SNAPSHOT: This import represents the complete dataset of the source.

conflictHint.latest-wins: When several sources write a property, the most recent timestamp wins.
conflictHint.source-priority: The source with the higher priority wins.
conflictHint.max-confidence: The value with the highest confidence wins.

rest.cursorParamHint: Query parameter carrying the incremental cursor (optional)
rest.cursorPathHint: JSONPath of the next cursor in the response (optional)
rest.secretHint: Sensitive headers (e.g. Authorization) are stored encrypted and never returned after creation.

issues.itemsPath: The records path must be a JSONPath starting with $, e.g. $.data.items

webhook.noticeTitle: The signing secret is shown only once
webhook.notice: Creating the source issues a push URL and an HMAC signing secret. The secret is shown only once after creation — store it safely. Senders sign requests with the X-OD-Timestamp and X-OD-Signature headers.
webhook.secretOnce: The secret is shown only once and cannot be viewed after leaving this page
webhook.secretGone: The secret was issued at creation and cannot be shown again.
webhook.signHint: Signature = HEX(HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + body)); the timestamp must be within 5 minutes.

mapping.title: Field mapping
mapping.subtitle: Map source fields to properties of “{type}” and configure transform chains.

err.TOO_MANY_STEPS: A transform chain has at most {max} steps

links.title: Links
links.hint: Optional: create links to other objects from field values.
links.none: The target type has no outgoing link types

ai.pendingNotice: {count, plural, one {# AI suggestion needs} other {# AI suggestions need}} confirmation and won’t apply until confirmed.
ai.done: AI returned {count, plural, one {# mapping suggestion} other {# mapping suggestions}}
ai.failed: Could not generate a mapping draft
ai.noSample: Sample data is needed to generate a draft

preview.title: Mapping preview
preview.subtitle: First sample row mapped with confirmed rows ({count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}})

issues.title: Mapping checks
issues.pkMissing: Choose the primary key source field
issues.duplicate: Property {prop} is mapped by several fields ({a}, {b})
issues.linkIncomplete: Links need a type and a target key field
issues.aiPending: {count, plural, one {# AI suggestion is} other {# AI suggestions are}} unconfirmed; unconfirmed suggestions are not applied

quality.title: Quality rules
quality.subtitle: Record-level checks per property; on failure reject, clamp into range or just warn.
quality.emptyHint: You can skip this step; schema type and required checks always apply.
quality.footnote: Rules run in order: the first failing “reject” rule rejects the record; “clamp into range” only applies to range rules.

issues.CLAMP_NOT_RANGE: “Clamp into range” only applies to range rules
issues.RANGE_ARG: Enter a minimum and a maximum (min ≤ max)
issues.FRESHNESS_ARG: Freshness must be a number of hours greater than 0

preview.rowsSubtitle: Dry run in the browser with the current mapping, transforms and quality rules
preview.statsSubtitle: Client-side pre-check over all {count, number} rows

stats.warned: {count, plural, one {# row triggers} other {# rows trigger}} warning rules (still imported)

preview.reasonCount: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} · e.g. row {row}
preview.allValid: All records pass the client-side checks
preview.planSubtitle: The raw file is archived, then batches are submitted concurrently

plan.batchesValue: {count, plural, one {# batch} other {# batches}} × ≤ {size} rows
plan.note: Rejected records are kept for 30 days and can be fixed and replayed on the job page.

progress.retrying: {count, plural, one {# batch} other {# batches}} waiting to retry

summary.title: Summary
summary.restNote: Once enabled the source is pulled every 15 minutes; disable it from the source list.

job.title: Import job

rejected.title: Rejected records
rejected.subtitle: Edit values in place, then replay; rejected records are kept for 30 days.
rejected.replayed: Requeued {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}
